assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of symptomatic paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The symptoms are suggestive of sick sinus syndrome
There is underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic periods
The cardiac event monitoring study is medically necessary to address the member's symptomatic paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The cardiac event monitoring study is coded as CPT 93271
